title: Breaking the Static Graph: Context-Aware Traversal for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Kwun Hang Lau; Fangyuan Zhang; Boyu Ruan; Yingli Zhou; Qintian Guo; Ruiyuan Zhang; Xiaofang Zhou
why_relevant: Proposes a graph-based RAG method that mitigates semantic drift in multi-hop retrieval, tangentially related to noisy retrieval robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Primary focus is improving multi-hop retrieval accuracy via dynamic graph traversal, not directly studying robustness to noise, conflict, adversaries, or calibration.
